reset_roster_policy: Exactly13 unique readable non-command registers; all defined bits including CR1.ACCESS/WINDOW compared with own reset. No KEY or ICR reads. TIME/ALARMA/ALARMB reset0x00120000; AWTARR0xFFFF. This is a deliberately conservative software contract.
read_policy: Controls first and reject on mismatch before COMPEN/calendar reads; repeat entire snapshot. No WINDOW wait, ACCESS, KEY, reset, flag clear or RTC write during RCC admission.
wake_policy: Own PDF181 rawRTCCLK wake sources0..3 operate withoutSTART; only sources4..7 requireRTC1Hz andSTART. START0 alone is insufficient.
compensation_policy: Own PDF177 Table12-3 allows compensatedLSE1Hz withSOURCEignored; any nonreset snapshot across everySOURCE blocks disabled-source startup.
retention_policy: Enabled exact source reuse bypasses new-source consumer admission and never rewrites retained RTC. New source start requires pristine snapshot and never manufactures it.
calendar_policy: Own PDF176 §12.3.5 explicitly permits consecutive matching TIME or DATE reads. Bounded T-D-T-D-T verifies a snapshot but does not promise atomic rollover or post-fault continuity. Held-source health checks before and after attach/now remain.
no_claims: No automatic LSE request inferred from SDK silence.
No RTC migration, reset, compensation setup, low-power support or clock-fault recovery.
No silicon execution or crystal waveform/accuracy guarantee.
